markdown.markdown:
This portfolio is live-instrumented with **Google Analytics 4 (GA4)** — not just as a tracking tool, but as a demonstration of real production analytics skills. Every pageview, recruiter interaction, and conversion is measured and attributed.

---


GA4 is connected through Quarto's native integration, requiring only a few lines in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
website:
  google-analytics:
    tracking-id: "_quarto.yml"
    anonymize-ip: true
```

---

## What gets tracked

Standard pageviews are captured out of the box. On top of that, four custom events fire on recruiter-relevant actions:

| Event | Fired when | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| `resume_download` | Resume PDF is clicked | Strongest signal of recruiter interest |
| `project_view` | A case study is opened | Shows which work resonates |
| `contact_click` | Email or LinkedIn is clicked | Indicates outreach intent |
| `presentation_viewed` | Presentation page loads | Measures technical content reach |

Each event is attached via `gtag('event', ...)` on the relevant page element.

---

## Conversion tracking

Two events are elevated to **Key Events** in GA4:

- **Resume download** — the clearest indicator a recruiter is seriously interested
- **Contact click** — signals the visitor is moving toward direct outreach

Together they enable a simple but meaningful funnel: *land → explore → convert*.

---

## SEO setup

Discoverability is handled at the `_quarto.yml` level:

```yaml
website:
  open-graph: true
  twitter-card: true
  title: "Kelly Liang | Marketing Analytics"
  description: "Portfolio of Kelly Liang — Marketing Analytics professional skilled in R, Excel, and Google Analytics."
```

---

## Search Console

The site is verified in Google Search Console, providing visibility into:

- Which search queries surface the portfolio
- Click-through rates by page
- Core Web Vitals and mobile usability
- Indexing coverage and any crawl errors

---

## Reporting

A Looker Studio dashboard is connected directly to this GA4 property, surfacing traffic, engagement, and conversion data in a shareable format. This closes the loop from raw instrumentation all the way through to stakeholder-ready reporting.
